g.text: REFERENCE RENDER (ISO2) — rendered off this solid,

THROUGH MATERIAL, NOT A WALL: AT AN EDGE, A FILLET RUN-OUT
OR A CHAMFER TIP IT IS REAL AND UNPRINTABLE BY DEFINITION.
DO NOT JUDGE PRINTABILITY BY IT — THE NEXT NOTE IS THE ONE
